answer_1.quote: Specifically, we fine-tune BioT5 on molecule captioning and text-based molecule generation tasks.
answer_1.outputs: For molecule captioning: text descriptions; for text-based molecule generation: SELFIES strings

answer_2.quote: In the molecule caption task, NLP metrics like BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR are utilized to evaluate the closeness of the generated description to the ground truth description. ... Additionally, we also report performance on molecule-specific metrics: three molecule fingerprints (FTS) similarity scores-MACCS, RDK, and Morgan; Levenshtein distance; FCD score ... validity, which is the percentage of the valid SMILES that can be processed by RDKit.
